hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; command -v turnstile >/dev/null && exec turnstile hook claude-stop; if [ -f flake.nix ]; then for n in nix /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix; do command -v $n >/dev/null && exec $n develop -c turnstile hook claude-stop; done; fi; echo '{"systemMessage": "turnstile is not installed, so the checks of this repo did not run at agent stop. See https://github.com/a-grasso/turnstile#install"}'
